recommendation: Keep the source fix. A future formal invariant for the single-discriminator rule could be considered separately by the work group/tooling maintainers, but the narrative and code-list guidance now match the approved FHIR-26944 decision.
issue_request: Published/Persuasive FHIR-core issue requesting support for slicing by element order through ElementDefinition.slicing.discriminator.type = "position" and the constraints recorded in the FHIR-I discussion.
initial_application: Commit 1740aadf7cdadffaaaf4c8ffc4726d9005fd202f added the position discriminator code and fixed-cardinality guidance to source/datatypes/elementdefinition.xml and source/profiling.html, but omitted the approved $this path and prohibition on combining position with other discriminators.
additional_context: FHIR-I minutes from 2020-04-27 confirm the Jira comment's details: use $this for the path, require all but the last slice to have fixed cardinality, and prohibit position in an array with other discriminators. Later Zulip discussion treats position as an R5 feature and does not show a conflicting later decision.
reconciliation: Updated the active ElementDefinition spreadsheet source and built profiling page source to state that position uses discriminator path $this and must be the only slicing.discriminator entry, while preserving the existing cardinality rule.
source_changes: source/datatypes/elementdefinition.xml: clarified the position discriminator code definition to require path '$this' and make 'position' the only discriminator in the slicing.discriminator array.
source/profiling.html: added the same $this path and single-discriminator rule to the profiling table's position discriminator guidance.
